definitions.explanation: A piece of furniture used for storing clothing. Can refer to a freestanding cabinet with shelves, a closet-like wardrobe, or open shelving for garments.

examples.japanese: {衣装棚|いしょうだな}を{整理|せいり}した。
{新|あたら}しい{衣装棚|いしょうだな}を{寝室|しんしつ}に{置|お}いた。
examples.english: I put a new wardrobe in the bedroom.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しのときに{衣装棚|いしょうだな}が{大|おお}きすぎて{部屋|へや}に{入|はい}らなくて{困|こま}った。
examples.english: When I moved, the wardrobe was too big to fit in the room and I was stuck.

notes:
Composed of {衣装|いしょう} (clothing, costume) + {棚|たな} (shelf, rack). Refers to any shelved or cabinet-style furniture for storing clothes, distinct from a built-in closet ({押|お}し{入|い}れ or クローゼット).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {衣装棚|いしょうだな}を{整理|せいり}する: to organize the wardrobe
- {衣装棚|いしょうだな}に{入|い}れる: to put in the wardrobe
- {衣装棚|いしょうだな}を{買|か}う: to buy a wardrobe
- {衣装棚|いしょうだな}の{中|なか}: inside the wardrobe

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {洋服|ようふく}ダンス: Western-style wardrobe — specifically a tall cabinet for hanging clothes
- クローゼット: closet — a built-in storage space, often walk-in style
- {押|お}し{入|い}れ: Japanese-style closet — traditional sliding-door storage in tatami rooms, used for futons and clothing
- {タンス}: chest of drawers — a drawer-based furniture piece for folded clothing
